about: Statistics Netherlands (CBS) StatLine. immigration = moved to the Netherlands from Poland, 2014-2025, table 85671NED (country of departure/destination, all ages, sexes and countries of birth). emigration = moved from the Netherlands to Poland: 2014-2025 from 85671NED (emigration excluding administrative corrections), 2000-2011 from the discontinued table 82350NED (emigrants by destination, published in thousands to one decimal, so rounded to 100). No country-level emigration is published for 2012-2013. Fetched from the CBS OData API (opendata.cbs.nl) in November 2026.
